evidence.description: Codex scan found 6 IBR headers with signature pattern 0xA5 [ZBW] 0x31 [WBZ] 0xA5. All headers identical: Field A=0x00001010, Field B=0x00888800. All have data/code following header.
Header #1 @ 0x00000200 (RAW): Active bootloader with ARM code immediately after header. This is the SoC boot entry point.
Headers #2,3,5 @ 0x179dcc, 0x247aa68, 0x3c7bd70 (RAW): Firmware Set A lookup tables containing: 3:/ZK-INKJET-BOOT.bin, 3:/ZK-INKJET-CUTE-BOOT.bin, 3:/ZK-TIJSPS-800x480-BOOT.bin
Header #4 @ 0x306cfa8 (RAW): Firmware Set B lookup table containing: 3:/ZK-INKJET-TINY-BOOT.bin, 3:/ZK-INKJET-PUNY-BOOT.bin, 3:/ZK-INKJET-NANO-BOOT.bin, 3:/ZK-INKJET-UI.bin

Header #6 @ 0x24098fa8: Located inside deleted APP.bin in Volume 2 at relative offset +0x6CFA8 (446,376 bytes). Contains same Set B filenames as header #4. This is embedded firmware data, not a separate RAW header.

Boot sector (0x000-0x200) is completely empty (512 bytes of zeros). No MBR, no partition table, no 0x55AA signature. SD card is not normally mountable - FAT volumes exist at fixed RAW offsets without partition table.

provenance: Codex binary search of SD image (2026-01-14) + manual analysis
summary: Six IBR headers exist in SD image. Header #1 (0x200) contains active BOOT code. Headers #2-5 are RAW-stored firmware filename lookup tables for update system. Header #6 (0x24098fa8) is embedded within APP.bin firmware at relative offset +0x6CFA8. Two distinct firmware variant sets identified: Set A (BOOT/CUTE/TIJSPS) and Set B (TINY/PUNY/NANO/UI).
title: IBR Header Locations & Firmware Update Lookup Tables
